summary.text: Stan Kitzman, of Pattison in Waller County, is the State Representative for Texas House District 85, which serves Austin, Colorado, Fayette, Waller and Wharton counties and part of Fort Bend County. His official biography says he serves on the House Appropriations Committee and the Agriculture and Livestock Committee.

paragraphs.text: Kitzman is a sixth-generation Texan who graduated from Royal High School and earned a Bachelor of Science degree in Agricultural Systems Management from Texas A&M University.
He is a small business owner, former Waller County Commissioner and former public school teacher.
He retired after 21 years in the Texas Army National Guard, deployed three times in support of Operation Iraqi Freedom, and received the Combat Infantryman Badge and the Bronze Star Medal.
As a second-term legislator he chairs the Appropriations Article III subcommittee and was elected to chair the bicameral Water Caucus.
